name: of1-deep-dive-how-it-works
description: A how-it-works explainer that walks the visitor through a numbered step-by-step sequence of how the product or technology works, backed by a benefits section and a closing call to action.

slots.instruction: Short kicker above the headline signalling this is a how-it-works explainer.
Headline framing what process or technology the page explains.
One-sentence plain-language summary of the path the explainer will walk through.
Primary hero call to action linking to the relevant product or learn page.
Heading introducing the numbered step-by-step sequence.
Short lead-in sentence setting up the steps that follow.
Title of the first step in the sequence.
Explanation of what happens in the first step.
Title of the second step in the sequence.
Explanation of what happens in the second step.
Title of the third step in the sequence.
Explanation of what happens in the third step.
Title of the fourth step in the sequence.
Explanation of what happens in the fourth step.
Title of the optional fifth step. Leave empty to hide.
Explanation of the optional fifth step. Leave empty to hide.
Heading for the supporting benefits or spec section.
Short paragraph connecting how the setup works to the visitor's real-world benefit.
Bulleted list of the concrete benefits or specs that result from how it works.
Supporting product image. Use a real Xfinity asset URL.
Closing call-to-action heading.
Closing call-to-action supporting copy.
Final call to action to start the order or continue.

label: Deep Dive - How It Works
